name: Bread pudding (broodpudding)
source: ESTIMATE: recipe-based (Flemish bakery broodpudding: 500 g stale white bread, 1 L whole milk, 4 eggs, 200 g brown sugar, 150 g raisins, 50 g butter, 12% baking loss; ingredient values NEVO/USDA generic). Cross-check: USDA FNDDS 13210110 "Pudding, bread with raisins" = 156 kcal (moister, less bread) - Belgian bakery slices are denser.

name: Bread and butter pudding
source: ESTIMATE: recipe-based (UK classic: 180 g buttered white bread + 30 g butter, 3 eggs, 310 g whole milk, 150 g double/whipping cream, 50 g sugar, 50 g sultanas, 10% baking loss). Commercial UK range ~160-240 kcal/100 g (e.g. M&S label 240 kcal, F 15.1).

name: Rice tart (rijsttaart)
source: NEVO-Online 2025 9.0, code 489 "Vlaai rijste-" (Flan filled w rice pudding), https://nevo-online.rivm.nl. Matches Belgian label Partout "Rijsttaart stuk 120g" (211 kcal, F 5.5, C 34.9, sugars 19).

name: Sugar tart (suikertaart)
source: Product label: Defroidmont (BE) "Tarte au sucre et vergeoise", per 100 g via Open Food Facts / informationsnutritionnelles.fr (1495 kJ). Fibre not declared -> 1.5 g estimated.

name: Mattentaart (Geraardsbergse mattentaart)
source: Product label: Partout "Mattentaart stuk 115g" (BE), PS in foodservice https://psinfoodservice.com/en/product/2610578-partout-mattentaart-stuk-115g/ (salt 0.75 g -> Na 300 mg). Diversi Foods mattentaartje 115 g similar (388 kcal).

name: Frangipane tartlet (frangipanetaartje)
source: Product labels, average of Molco "Frangipanetaartje" 80 g (puff pastry, frangipane, white icing) and Holeki "Frangipane taartje rond" (with apricot jam, fondant), PS in foodservice codes 1751441 / 1760461, https://psinfoodservice.com

name: Meringue cream pastry
source: Product label: Picard "2 merveilleux au chocolat" (175 g), per 100 g via Open Food Facts. Other labels 347-431 kcal (Casino 376).

name: Raisin brioche (kramiek)
source: Product label: Delhaize (BE) "Cramique", per 100 g via Open Food Facts. NEVO 244 "Tarwerozijnenbrood wit" (272 kcal, F 2.7) is the leaner Dutch raisin bread.

name: Sugar bread (suikerbrood)
source: Product label: Belgian "Mini Craquelins Frais" per 100 g via Open Food Facts (fibre not declared -> 2.0 estimated). Note: Dutch Fries suikerbrood is leaner - NEVO 2355 "Tarwesuikerbrood wit" 306 kcal, F 3.0, sugars 28.5.

name: Liège waffle (Luikse wafel)
source: NEVO-Online 2025 9.0, code 2661 "Wafel Luikse-" (average of O'Lacy, Albert Heijn, Lotus, Bellbake), https://nevo-online.rivm.nl

name: Brussels waffle (Brusselse wafel)
source: Product labels, average of Delhaize (BE), Carrefour "Les Belges" (BE) and Thiriet "Gaufres de Bruxelles" (via Open Food Facts) + ESTIMATE 8 g icing sugar per 85 g waffle. Street/bakery waffles made with butter will have more saturated fat.

name: Berliner with custard (berlinerbol)
source: NEVO-Online 2025 9.0, code 1470 "Berliner bol", https://nevo-online.rivm.nl. Belgian bakery versions with generous pastry cream can run ~300-350 kcal/100 g (AH label 346).

name: Cinnamon roll (kaneelbroodje)
source: Product labels, average of glazed kaneelbroodje from Albert Heijn, Picnic, PLUS and Crisp (NL), via Open Food Facts. US-style cream-cheese-frosted bun is richer: USDA SR Legacy 18964 "Cinnamon buns, frosted" 452 kcal, F 26.6.

name: Portuguese custard tart (pastel de nata)
source: Product labels, average of 6 (Lidl, Gamberina, Polinorte PT, HMF, a Portuguese bakery entry, Pret) via Open Food Facts / pret.co.uk; fibre set to 1.5 (labels 0.9-4.0, median-ish).

name: Apple strudel (appelstrudel)
source: USDA FoodData Central SR Legacy 18354 "Strudel, apple" (fdcId 175032). Butter-made bakery strudel has more saturated fat (USDA FNDDS 53440000: 281 kcal, sat 7.6). Not the Dutch appelcarre (NEVO 833).

name: Cupcake with buttercream
source: ESTIMATE: recipe-based (50 g butter sponge = NEVO 1969 "Cake m roomboter" + 30 g butter buttercream: 32% butter, 64% icing sugar, 4% milk). USDA FNDDS bakery cupcakes with white icing (53120270) = 359 kcal but use shortening-based icing.

name: Carrot cake with cream-cheese frosting (worteltaart)
source: NEVO-Online 2025 9.0, code 5254 "Carrotcake" (with walnuts and cream-cheese glaze), https://nevo-online.rivm.nl

name: Coffee butter-cream almond pastry
source: Product labels, average of 4 Belgian javanais (La Lorraine, Delhaize, Paul Gaelens artisanal, Holeki) via Open Food Facts; fibre set to 1.5 (labels 0.9-3.7).

name: Almond butter-cream cake
source: Product labels, average of 4 Belgian misérable (incl. Carrefour BE 125 g) via Open Food Facts; fibre set to 1.5 (only one label declared, 1.3).

name: Double cream puff, chocolate or coffee (dubbele soes)
source: Product labels, average of 5 chocolate religieuses (Tartefrais, Hafner, Patigel, La Campaniere, unbranded) via Open Food Facts; coffee version is equivalent within label spread.

name: Brussels Greek bread (Grieks brood)
source: Product label: Maison Dandoy (Brussels) "Pain a la grecque", per 100 g via Open Food Facts.
